walkthrough.formula: Take any model M of ∀x (Human(x) ∧ Mortal(x)).
walkthrough.explanation: Let d be an arbitrary object of its domain.
The premise holds at d. Both predicate memberships follow.
The object d was arbitrary, so every domain object belongs to Human.
The same reasoning shows that every domain object belongs to Mortal.
Both conjuncts are true in every model of the premise.
